digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Records / reconciler vendor backend adapter seam
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family sub-seam layer, its two parameterizing contracts, and the shared-jira provenance decision with explicit deferral of generalizations to epic be74

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only if the port is complete and typed; TicketTransport declares 6 members while the core reaches for 21 distinct transport members, with 12 absent from DC and undeclared in any Protocol, causing silent failures in outbound operations despite passing isinstance checks and unit tests
RemoteRef.instance is an intended design with an unimplemented gap, never constructed in production code; the ADR must state it as design intent with the gap ticketed, not as existing reality
The Jira Data Center adapter is a deliberately time-boxed investment ending 28 March 2029 when DC goes read-only; the durable asset is the family seam architecture, not the DC adapter itself

Documentation must be executable and verified against live instances; the user guide config block must be parsed from the guide at runtime and executed against the jira-dc-harness to prevent guide rot

The port-incompleteness defect is a property of the seam architecture, not the DC adapter; epic be74 (GitHub Issues) inherits the same wall and must account for complete typing of transport parameters to make gaps visible to mypy
